what: a loft from the circle on top of a cylinder (r 10, height 15) to a 40 x 30 rectangle 30 mm above, joined to the cylinder (builds as a new body in 2 ms, the join never returns)
method: the loft pairing of circle and rectangle is not canonical, so no volume is graded: the join must give one closed valid solid in the hull of the cylinder and both sections, bbox x +-20, y +-15, z 0..45.
